cuhkAdmission.introduction: Nurturing Mathematics Teachers with a Professional Attitude The B.Ed. (Mathematics and Mathematics Education) is an interdisciplinary programme co-organized by the Faculty of Education and the Department of Mathematics of CUHK. It is a double major undergraduate programme, in which students learn solid mathematical knowledge and receive integrated teacher training in both theory and practice. Teachers in the programme are well known scholars in mathematics, mathematics education or educational studies. By means of lectures, experiential learning, and teaching practice in secondary schools, the students acquire both mathematics and teacher professional knowledge, develop transferable skills in research and practice, and are equipped to assume leadership roles in mathematics teaching. Graduates are awarded a Bachelor of Education degree with a double major in Mathematics and Mathematics Education, including a qualification equivalent to a Postgraduate Diploma in Education, and are qualified to teach in secondary schools.
cuhkAdmission.ranking: The CUHK Faculty of Education is ranked 11 th in the world and 4 th in Asia in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings (Education Studies) 2025.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: The majority of BMED graduates join the teaching profession. With experience over time, some have assumed leading roles in mathematics teaching in secondary schools. With their solid knowledge and skills developed in this programme, some graduates have pursued careers in a wide range of professions, such as academic research, science and technology, finance and banking, the civil service and publishing. The programme also lays a firm foundation for graduates who desire to pursue advanced studies in mathematics, mathematics education, or related areas. In addition to knowledge and skills, we value developing students’ attitudes and professionalism. This is perhaps what our students treasure the most about the BMED programme. More BMED students’ views can be accessed on  YouTube . If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: Students enrolled in the BMED programme learn both mathematics and educational theories. The programme design is stimulating and rewarding; its interdisciplinary nature equips our students with both subject matter and pedagogical knowledge and skills, thereby advancing their interests and passion in the fields of mathematics and education. The BMED programme also offers courses for students to enhance their subject-specific skills, such as the teaching and learning of geometry, statistics and calculus; tasks designs in STEM education; and contemporary issues in mathematics education. These courses enable them to reflect on what it means to teach and learn mathematics in the 21st century. The students’ development in all areas of mathematics and mathematics education is significant and rigorous, enabling them to see and teach mathematics from an advanced perspective.
